LanguageData.TXWC_TankCapacityDesc: How much chemfuel a full tank holds. The gauge counts it in units of one. Lowering it below a tank's current fill drops the excess. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_GasPerChemfuelDesc: How many cells of tox gas each chemfuel in the tank makes, however it is spent: vented, jetted, or burst when the pilot goes down. The absorb banks a chemfuel's worth per that much gas drawn in. A tox pack fills 45 cells from 35 chemfuel. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_VentRateDesc: How fast the vent empties the tank. A faster vent makes a wider cloud that clears sooner. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_TankSummary: A full tank: {0} chemfuel for {1} cells of tox gas ({2} tox packs). The vent empties it in {3} seconds.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetCostDesc: How much chemfuel each gas jet draws from the tank. Without a tank, one of the shoulders' own jets makes the same gas for the same chemfuel. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetReserveDesc: How many jets the shoulders hold on their own, for wear without the tank. They reload with chemfuel and are untouched while a tank is worn. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetConeWidthDesc: The full width of the cone the gas jet lands in. A wider cone spreads the same gas thinner. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetRangeDesc: How far the gas jet reaches. A longer jet spreads the same gas thinner. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetSummary: A jet: {0} chemfuel for {1} cells of tox gas ({2} tox packs). A full tank holds {3}, the shoulders alone {4}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbRadiusDesc: How far around the pilot the absorb draws gas in. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbDurationDesc: How long each absorb keeps drawing gas in. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbCooldownDesc: How long the absorb takes to recharge. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbSummary: One absorb draws from the {0} cells around the pilot. A full cloud over them banks {1} chemfuel.
LanguageData.TXWC_HazardVacuumDesc: Gives the hazard warcasket the vacuum resistance of the spacer warcaskets, setting it further apart from the toxin warcasket. Changing this requires a restart. Default: off.
LanguageData.TXWC_FeedToxAbsorptionDesc: Pilots with the tox absorption gene ({0}) absorb gas from the tank as if standing in a tox cloud, so their pollution mutations grow whenever the tank is not empty. Costs no gas. Default: on.
